candidates.snippet: Ukraine has launched another massive drone attack targeting Russia and Russian-occupied territories. https://t.co/sboyMA2gE1

Loud booms were heard near Saudi Aramco’s headquarters in Dhahran, with sources reporting a fire, an evacuation order and a possible strike on the building.

Saudi authorities said debris from an intercepted missile fell on a residential area.

Source: Reuters

U.S. official on Iran:

Bibi seems to want to go in again. He has talked to the president about it a couple times, and the president has said, "Well, you know, Bibi, go ahead and get ready."

But there's really no commitment. "Go ahead and get ready" is maybe now, maybe later,
